name: Shortbread cookies
instructions: - Cream together the butter and sugar, til pale and soft (at least some minutes). Slowly mix in the flour.
- Make a decently thick sheet and cut in 12 bars.
- Transfer onto a baking tray, preheat oven to 176ºC, freeze for 10' and bake until slightly golden (25').
- Allow them to cool before handling, or they will crumble.
